# odigos Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "odigos" {
  hostname = "<hostname>"
  username = "<username>"
  password = "<password>"
  insecure = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) The Odigos API hostname. Can also be set via ODIGOS_HOSTNAME.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Whether to skip TLS verification when connecting to the Odigos API.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The Odigos API password. Can also be set via ODIGOS_PASSWORD.
- `username` (String) The Odigos API username. Can also be set via ODIGOS_USERNAME.
